page.overview:
Who is Suilin Escanda?

Suilin Escanda was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah who was raised to the Amyrlin Seat in the year.

Her name indicates that she was almost certainly from Tear.

Suilin held the position for forty-one years until her resignation in the series. She was Aliane Senican's successor and Nirelle Coidevwin's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Suilin was an Amyrlin of moderate strength who involved the Tower in a number of foreign intrigues.
